description: Prepared input folder for the standard NonLinLoc adapter.

required_files.stations_native.txt: Whitespace table: station_id longitude latitude elevation_m
required_files.picks_simple.txt: Whitespace table: station_id phase time_seconds first_motion

modes.native_obs: Requires velocity_model_1d.txt, stations_native.txt and event.obs when --native-obs is supplied.

read_only: The input directory is read only; all controls, grids, logs and parsed locations are written to the output directory.
